declarations.name: A116.Wazn.WaznC
declarations.declaration_excerpt:
structure WaznC (n : Nat) where
  wasl : Bool
  body : List (CSym n)
  last : Fin n
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: A116.Wazn.fillC_determines_root
declarations.declaration_excerpt:
theorem fillC_determines_root {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (t : List (CSym n)) (r r' : Root n), fillC t r = fillC t r' →
      ∀ i h, CSym.slot i h ∈ t → r i = r' i
  | [], _, _, _, _, _, hm => by simp at hm
  | s :: t, r, r', e, i, h, hm => by
    simp only [fillC, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at e
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hm with rfl | hm
    · have

declarations.name: A116.Wazn.realize_determines_root
declarations.declaration_excerpt:
theorem realize_determines_root {n : Nat} (W : WaznC n) (r r' : Root n) (en : Entry) (ex : Exit)
    (h : Haraka) (e : realize W r en ex h = realize W r' en ex h) (hw : waslH W r = waslH W r') :
    r W.last = r' W.last ∧ ∀ i h', CSym.slot i h' ∈ W.body → r i = r' i

declarations.name: A116.RootGrade.num_inj
declarations.declaration_excerpt:
theorem num_inj : ∀ r s : List (Fin 28), r.length = s.length → num r = num s → r = s
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => by simp at h
  | d :: t, d' :: t', hl, hn => by
    simp only [num] at hn
    have h1

declarations.name: A116.RootGrade.num_unnum
declarations.declaration_excerpt:
theorem num_unnum : ∀ k n : Nat, n < 28 ^ k → num (unnum k n) = n
  | 0, n, h => by simp [unnum, num] at *; omega
  | k + 1, n, h => by
    have hk : n / 28 < 28 ^ k

requested_category_inventory.finding: RootGrade labels supplied original-radical counts 3/4 as mutasarrif and 5 as jamid by definition. This neither counts original radicals from spelling nor decides nominal semantic jamid/mushtaq.

Six named semantic source constructors in Khawass; the QiraaMadlul witness maps three supplied roots to those sources. No general masdar-pattern extractor or unique verb-to-masdar rule is established here.

One triliteral faail template among eight declared reading templates. Candidate matching over a supplied root list ignores only the final nominal vowel. Template shape is shared with Form III imperative.
One triliteral mafool template with declared ismMafool label. This is not a general weak-root or nontriliteral participle derivation procedure, nor an actual object-role assignment.

boundaries.finding: extract skips literal positions without checking their values, tolerates mismatched lengths by returning partial lists, and proves only extraction from a filled template. A recognizer must validate length/literals and replay fill.
VII applied to ت ب ر and VIII applied to ن ب ر yield the same supplied template form انْتَبَر. Fixed-template injectivity does not make root inference unique.
أَعْلَمُ/أَحْسَنُ/أَكْبَرُ share the checked afal shape; قَاتِلْ/جَاهِدِ/كَاتِبُ share its faail predicate. A successful shape predicate is not a semantic category decision.
The defined neutralization maps قول and قيل to the same قال cells; it also collapses the III/IV applications to ءمن. Root/template provenance cannot be recovered uniquely from those cells.
The header explicitly distinguishes all nine past/imperfect vowel combinations licensed by the cell law from the six lexical babs. Choosing the correct lexical middle vowel is external evidence.

The modules agree only on a restricted shared reference set; first/middle-hamza roots are excluded. The code explicitly demonstrates different ءمن outputs, and Mudari has an additional named رأى shortening rule.

Wazn uses an article-oriented wasl-vowel rule that opens before root lam; the verb-oriented rule in Mudari closes the imperative of لقي/VIII with kasra. Do not transfer the broad Wazn entry-vowel rule unchanged.

رأى and أخذ/أكل/أمر are named branches. Some pause behavior is deposited from remaining radical count, not forced by syllable acceptance. Correctness of named linguistic branches is separate from list algebra.

IX is absent from the 31 templates and Mudari.Form. افعنلل is explicitly unavailable in Rubai for lack of a sealed vowel witness. Hollow passive and several transformations remain outside Neutral realization.

Word class, lexical root list, root-to-masdar mapping, usage, temporal descriptions and frame assumptions remain supplied. Labeling an output ismFaail or filMajhul does not prove a real sentence role.
ofStr3 reads the first three characters with defaults. It is a representation helper for declared data, not an admissibility checker for arbitrary input root strings.

Derivation is a ten-node, nine-edge authored Markov graph; its exact stationary-vector theorem proves the graph arithmetic, not lexical derivability, template recognition or universal Arabic frequency.

Original-radical degree, conjugating/frozen root families, semantic jamid/mushtaq, and actual lexical derivation are distinct. Dalalat explicitly disproves a pattern-only mutawaa decision on its declared examples.

recommended_first_slice: Typed slot/literal templates with source-bound root candidates, exact replay, explicit pattern identity and ambiguity, and a transparent inventory of requested categories. Generated template labels must not activate lexical, semantic, tense, voice or syntactic classifications without independent evidence.
